title: Legacy Text Input Contract Audit, TTUTIL Suitability & Adapter Qualification
qualification_scope: revision-53 input-family audit, defaults/error contracts, TTUTIL suitability, exact official TTUTIL 4.27 source provenance, strict legacy-versus-native adapter policy, and bounded DIRECT/animo.ini representation-only runtime qualification; no production input migration

legacy_undefined_behavior_exclusion.reason: revision-53 can form Fname(0:Ilast) when Istart remains zero and Ilast is positive

verification.github_actions_note: The persisted pilot harness and committed evidence passed the IO01 workflow. Later documentation/status-only commits trigger additional workflow runs separately.

principal_findings: TTUTIL 4.27 source provenance is exact and hash-pinned from the supplied SWAP 4.3.1 distribution
the public SWAP-model/ttutil repository is not byte-identical to the official SWAP 4.3.1 embedded source and is reference-only
TTUTIL is useful parser infrastructure but is not a drop-in parser for the revision-53 legacy grammar
LegacyRevision53TextAdapter and TTUTILNativeTextAdapter/v1 are separate representation contracts
Pilot A produces 10/10 field-exact equivalent LegacyInputBinding/v1 routing semantics on the natural frozen testbank
legacy duplicate-known selectors remain last-wins and unknown selectors remain ignored only in legacy mode
native TTUTIL v1 fails closed on unknown, duplicate and missing mandatory schema keys
revision-53 Strip has an empty/whitespace-only quoted-payload out-of-bounds edge that must not be normalized into fake deterministic semantics
ANIMO41 GENERAL remains sequentially order-sensitive and is not qualified by DIRECT Pilot A
INITIAL and restart state remain specialized state adapters
external crop and soil-temperature time series remain specialized forcing/exchange adapters
GHGMais remains lineage-sensitive; routing equality does not qualify its GHG input schema

pilot_selection.pilot_B_candidate: MAT non-GHG static core using a natural case such as RuurloGrass

next_safe_steps: start a separately bounded Pilot B for the non-GHG static MATERIAL core on RuurloGrass or another natural non-GHG case
build a source-qualified legacy MATERIAL normalization oracle with exact section/cardinality/default semantics before any native TTUTIL mapping
compare MATERIAL normalized fields, array dimensions, units and presence/default flags before model-output regression
keep GHGMais and cross-lineage GHG fields outside Pilot B
do not generalize the DIRECT Pilot A result to GENERAL, SOIL, PLANT, management, restart or binary hydrology
